user_query: Modify my reservation for room 714 from 2025-02-20 to 2025-02-22. Change it to room 1119 from 2025-03-15 to 2025-03-17.
agent_response:
I couldn’t modify that reservation because **room 1119 isn’t available for all the nights** you requested (**2025-03-15 to 2025-03-17, 2 nights**). **No changes were made**—your booking for **room 714 (2025-02-20 to 2025-02-22, 2 nights)** is still in place.

If you tell me what room type/view/occupancy you want for **2025-03-15 to 2025-03-17**, I can show you some available alternatives to switch into. I can also help look up information about the hotel and its offerings (amenities, services, policies).
